name: Door counts against bookings
description: Spec §14.3, §14.6: door clicker totals against booked and arrived guests.

parameters.name: Dataset
parameters.description: live = real clubs (analytics schema); demo = Velora only (analytics_demo schema)

cards.name: Door in, booked pax and arrived pax
cards.sql: select * from (select club_id, night_date, door_in, door_out, door_net, booked_pax, arrived_pax from analytics.door_vs_bookings where {{dataset}} = 'live' union all select club_id, night_date, door_in, door_out, door_net, booked_pax, arrived_pax from analytics_demo.door_vs_bookings where {{dataset}} = 'demo') d where true [[and d.club_id = {{club}}]] order by club_id, night_date
